Yamato: "Huh? The elevator's moving. You don't see that often.
Is someone on it, I wonder?"
Touya: "Well, people do ride it."
Yamato: "But every time I look, it's stopped.
Right on the floor I'm on, too."
Touya: "You're imagining things. Imagining things. Anyway..."
Yamato: "Oh, it stopped."
Fain: "Hahahahaha!
To defend my beloved, the blade of justice smites the enemy!
With crimson blood burning red, such is a man's path in life!
A man of justice and truth!
Faaain, Jiiin, Baaaarion!!
I have arrived! For justice... I can die!"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Aah!"
Fain: "H-Hey! Don't ignore me!
I was waiting specially for you..."
Touya: "...Get Gabon to take a look at you sometime."
Fain: "What?! I couldn't be healthier!
I'm not weak enough to get sick!
Dahahahaha!"
Yamato: "...It's a serious case."
Fain: "...So, what did you think? I'm pretty confident
in this one. Ah, my own talent frightens me."
It's pretty good, isn't it?
It's like enka.
Fain: "Isn't it? Especially the last part!
I get a thrill just saying it."
Yamato: "He's lost in admiration of himself... It's terminal."
Touya: "R-Right. Well, keep at it."
Fain: "'Enka'? What's that?"
Yamato: "Hmm... Maybe something like 'the song of the Japanese
heart'?"
Fain: "Heart? You mean a song that resonates
straight through the soul?"
Yamato: "W-Well, something like that."
Fain: "Oh! So my proclamation is just that
magnificent!"
Yamato: "Y-Yeah... Maybe..."
Fain: "Dahahahaha! You understand perfectly!"
Yamato: "By the way, Fain, why are you so
straightforward?"
Fain: "Heh heh heh... Because I believe in justice!
Dying for it would be my heart's desire!
And that justice is also for protecting those I hold dear!"
Touya: "Huh. Those you hold dear, eh..."
Fain: "Yes! For the princess, for Miss Ymir,
and for K-Kasumi... No! My justice is not
so fickle! Oh, what am I to do...?"
Yamato: "...What do we do?"
Touya: "Better keep our distance..."
Fain: "We're friends, aren't we?!
Tell me, who am I supposed to fight for?
I've decided in my heart that I'll love only one woman.
But I bear the noble and supreme
duty of guarding the princess. I can abandon neither love nor loyalty.
Ah... What a trial! This is the fate of a knight!
Then I shall press on! To fight destiny!
No, wait. But if one desires too much at once,
it's the same as losing everything, as my master said.
Does that mean I must follow one path or the other?!
Oh! How can this be?!
And choosing between Miss Ymir and Kasumi...
Damn it! It's all because those ≪Ze=Ode≫ bastards...
If not for them, I would never have had to suffer
like this...
Wait! Is this their conspiracy?!
Grrrrr! Damn them... How despicable...
No, how fearsome ≪Ze=Ode≫ is!
But I, Fain Jin Barion, will not let a little thing like that
break my spirit! Hmm? Does that mean,
to turn their plan against them, I must preserve my love for two women
and my loyalty to the princess
all at once?
No, but then I'd be defying my master's teaching.
Aaaah! What am I supposed to doooo?!"
Fain: "...Huh? Touya? Heeey..."
Yamato: "...He has it hard too."
Touya: "Well, he seems to find it fulfilling in his own way.
Anyway, let's go."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
Kasumi: "Oh, Touya-chan..."
Ymir: "Perfect timing. I was going to take Kasumi to her room,
but could you do it for me?
I can't leave my seat right now..."
Touya: "Her room?"
Ymir: "Yes. The room where Kasumi will be staying.
We've only done a little with the interior, but it's ready,
so she should be able to use it immediately."
Touya: "Hmm. So where is it?"
Ymir: "In the first section of the third level..."
Touya: "...Which means where?"
Yamato: "Oh, I knyow.
It's directly opposite Touya's room, isn't it?"
Ymir: "Yes. I'll leave it to you, then."
Kasumi: "Thank you.
Touya-chan, Yamato-chan, let's go."
Yamato: "Yeah! Let's be off!"
Ymir: "Aren't you going?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah... See you, then."
Ymir: "Yes."
Yamato: "Here it is."
Kasumi: "Well then..."
Touya: "Hmm? Is something wrong?"
Kasumi: "Why aren't you coming in?"
Touya: "Huh? Is that okay?"
Kasumi: "Why wouldn't it be? Don't be shy. Come in."
Yamato: "Well then..."
Touya: "Excuse us..."
Touya: "Hmm... It's pretty nice, isn't it?"
Kasumi: "Yeah. They've already helped me so much,
and even prepared a room like this..."
Touya: "Well, come to think of it, one room per person
is pretty good treatment. Meals included, too."
Kasumi: "Honestly, Touya-chan..."
Yamato: "Hey, Kasumi, you didn't bring any changes of clothes, did you?"
Kasumi: "No. But Mr. Bart said he'd get some for me."
Touya: "Come to think of it, Ai got him to get her a camera
too, didn't she...?"
Yamato: "...Couldn't Bart make a living
doing that sort of business?"
Touya: "Anyway, if that's the case,
there shouldn't be any problems for now."
Kasumi: "That's right. Oh, right.
Can I come and visit your room sometime, Touya-chan?"
Touya: "Huh? Sure, I don't mind..."
Kasumi: "It's in the section directly opposite
this room, isn't it?"
Yamato: "Ding-ding! That's Kasumi for you.
Your brain works better than Touya's."
Touya: "Well, excuse me."
Kasumi: "Heh heh heh. I'll look forward to that, then."
Touya: "Yeah."
Yamato: "Touya, Kasumi probably wants to rest,
so let's get going."
Touya: "Hmm? Yeah, you're right."
Kasumi: "Come and visit anytime."
Touya: "Yeah. See you, then."
Yamato: "Hello!"
Gabon: "Hmm? Lots of visitors today.
Wait a moment."
Yamato: "...That's what he says."
Touya: "Then let's wait."
Gabon: "...You're working too hard.
Keep this up, and you'll ruin your health one day.
Well, I injected a nutrient supplement, but don't rely on your Adjuster
too much. Everything has its limits."
Ymir: "Yes... I'm sorry."
Gabon: "That face says you don't get it... All right."
Gabon: "Hey, Touya."
Touya: "W-What?"
Gabon: "Take Ymir back to her room for me."
Touya: "Huh?"
Ymir: "But the work on countermeasures against ≪Ze=Ode≫'s field
still isn't..."
Gabon: "No. There's still time before we arrive.
Sleep for at least that long."
Ymir: "But... H-Huh... Ah........"
Touya: "H-Hey! Ymir! Are you all right?!"
Gabon: "It's finally taken effect..."
Touya: "Hey, what did you do?!"
Gabon: "Don't worry. I just injected her with sleep medication.
She won't listen unless I do something like this."
Touya: "Don't scare me like that..."
Yamato: "Come to think of it, this seems like a crime."
Gabon: "A-Ahem! W-Well, anyway,
take Ymir back to her room."
Touya: "Why not put her in that bed over there?"
Gabon: "If I did that, Miyasco would find out,
and I'd just end up banned from drinking again."
Yamato: "'Again'...?"
Gabon: "Anyway, you came looking for Ymir,
didn't you? You're here, so carry her back."
Touya: "How does that follow...?"
Gabon: "How long are you going to leave Ymir lying on the floor?"
Touya: "Tch... All right, all right!"
Gabon: "Don't assault her."
Touya: "As if I would!"
Touya: "..."
Touya: "........Huff, huff..."
Touya: "H-Hey... The scenery hasn't changed for a while..."
Yamato: "You're imagining it. The Liebhofen is ridiculously
huge, so it plays tricks on your eyes. I'm sure."
Touya: "..."
Touya: "...F-Finally, we're here..."
Yamato: "I hope the room isn't locked..."
Touya: "Huh...? Come to think of it, that could happen...
Hey, do we have to go all the way back again...?"
Yamato: "Oh, it's open."
Touya: "R-Right. Good..."
Touya: "First, let's put her in bed..."
Ymir: "Zzz, zzz."
Touya: "Phew..."
Yamato: "She's sleeping so peacefully."
Touya: "...Come to think of it, when we stayed in the Holy Land,
she said she'd been up all night too..."
Yamato: "Paldia also said she works a little
too hard... Maybe she's been pushing herself quite a bit."
Touya: "..."
Ymir: "...Mmm..."
Yamato: "Are you going to stand there watching Ymir sleep forever?
Come on, let's go."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
